quickAnswer.heading: Which Ritz-Carlton Yacht Is Best?
paragraphs: Our quick recommendation: Evrima — Best for travelers who want the most intimate Ritz-Carlton yacht experience. Ilma — Best overall choice for travelers who want a larger, newer yacht with expanded public spaces and an award-winning luxury experience. Luminara — Best for travelers who prioritize Asia-Pacific itineraries, newer design and generous space-per-guest.

If we had to choose: Best overall: Ilma | Best for intimacy: Evrima | Best for Asia-Pacific: Luminara | Best for space-per-guest: Luminara | Best for the original Ritz-Carlton yacht experience: Evrima | Best for travelers wanting the newest-generation experience: Ilma or Luminara.
But your itinerary should ultimately be the deciding factor.

atAGlanceTable.title: Evrima vs. Ilma vs. Luminara at a Glance
atAGlanceTable.description: The current official fleet information confirms 149 suites on Evrima, 224 on Ilma and 226 on Luminara, with each yacht designed around an all-suite experience, personalized service and marina access.

coreDifferencePillars.title: The Biggest Difference Between the Three Yachts
coreDifferencePillars.subtitle: The biggest mistake is to think: 'They're all Ritz-Carlton yachts, so they're basically identical.' They aren't. All share the core brand philosophy (all-suite accommodations, private terraces, personalized service, luxury dining, premium amenities, marina access, intimate yachting atmosphere), but each yacht has its own distinct personality.

pillars.title: Evrima: The Intimate Original
pillars.description: Launched Oct 2022 (624 ft, 149 suites, 298 guests). Defines the boutique small-yacht experience with maximum intimacy, quiet lounge spaces, and a private-yacht vibe.

pillars.title: Ilma: The Refined Next Generation
pillars.description: Launched Sep 2024 (790 ft, 224 suites, 448 guests). Expanded footprint, Forbes Five-Star recognition, larger upper suites, sun-soaked pool deck, and contemporary resort luxury.

pillars.title: Luminara: The Spacious Destination-Focused Yacht
pillars.description: Launched Jul 2025 (226 suites, 452 guests). Highest space-per-guest ratio, The Art Bar, enhanced pool decks, and spearheading Asia-Pacific and emerging region itineraries.

yachtTabbedComparisonData.name: 1. Evrima: The Original Ritz-Carlton Yacht
mainBrandStrengths: Launched October 2022 | 624 feet | 149 Suites | Max 298 Guests

Overview: Evrima is where the Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection began. Launched in October 2022, the yacht measures approximately 624 feet and has 149 suites accommodating up to 298 guests. Its smaller scale is a defining advantage. Particularly suited to immersive itineraries, personalized service and refined relaxation.

Smaller Guest Count: With approx. 298 guests, Evrima is significantly smaller than Ilma and Luminara, creating a more intimate atmosphere with fewer people around public areas, quieter dining, and easier social interactions.
Evrima Suites: 149 suites, all featuring private ocean-view terraces where guests enjoy morning coffee, read, order room-service breakfast, watch sail-away, and relax privately.

Evrima Dining: Features several dining experiences including S.E.A., combining fine dining, casual options, outdoor experiences, in-suite dining, and premium beverages in an intimate restaurant setting.
Evrima Marina: Direct stern access to water activities when conditions allow, including swimming, paddleboarding, kayaking, snorkeling, and watersports.
Evrima Itineraries: Mediterranean, Caribbean, French Polynesia, Cook Islands, and South Pacific (calling at Rangiroa, Fakarava, Rarotonga, Aitutaki).
competitorStrengths: Who Should Choose Evrima?: Choose Evrima if you want the smallest Ritz-Carlton yacht, maximum intimacy, a private-yacht feeling, couples-focused travel, a quieter experience, the original Ritz-Carlton yacht, Mediterranean or Caribbean itineraries, or a boutique environment.
Evrima Verdict: Best for Intimacy — If your priority is 'I want the Ritz-Carlton yacht experience to feel as much like a private yacht as possible', Evrima is the strongest choice.

yachtTabbedComparisonData.name: 2. Ilma: The Larger Next-Generation Yacht
mainBrandStrengths: Launched September 2024 | 790 feet | 224 Suites | Max 448 Guests

Overview: Ilma is the second yacht in the fleet and launched in September 2024. It measures approximately 790 feet and features 224 suites for up to 448 guests. Despite being larger than Evrima, Ilma maintains the all-suite, luxury-yacht concept with light-filled suites and a sun-soaked pool deck.
More Space: Larger physical footprint than Evrima with more room for lounges, dining, pool areas, wellness, public spaces, and entertainment while retaining an intimate feel.
Forbes Five-Star Distinction: Awarded Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rating in 2026 Star Awards — the world's first and only Five-Star cruise.
Ilma Suites: 224 suites with private terraces, introducing larger upper-suite categories exceeding 1,000 square feet for travelers desiring expansive living space.
Ilma Dining & Pools: Multiple dining environments (fine dining, casual, outdoor, chef-led, specialty, in-suite) and sun-soaked pool decks offering a resort-style layout.
Ilma Itineraries: Mediterranean, Northern Europe, Caribbean, and regional seasonal voyages across 27 scheduled ports.
competitorStrengths: Who Should Choose Ilma?: Choose Ilma if you want the newest-generation Ritz-Carlton experience, more public space, larger suites, expansive pool areas, contemporary design, strong luxury credentials (Forbes 5-Star), and a balance between intimacy and space.
Ilma Verdict: Best Overall for Luxury Travelers — Strikes a useful balance: small enough to feel like a yacht, but large enough to offer more space and variety.

yachtTabbedComparisonData.name: 3. Luminara: The Destination-Focused Newcomer
mainBrandStrengths: Entered Service July 2025 | 226 Suites | Max 452 Guests

Overview: Luminara entered service in July 2025. It has 226 suites and accommodates approximately 452 guests. The official Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection highlights Luminara's high space-per-guest ratio, enhanced pool decks, and signature venue, The Art Bar.
Destination Strategy: Expanded presence across Asia, Asia-Pacific, Alaska, South Pacific, connecting major cities with emerging seaside towns.
High Space-per-Guest Advantage: Generous space-per-guest ratio providing breathing room, larger public spaces, comfortable pool areas, and uncrowded lounges on longer voyages.
Luminara's Art Bar: Distinguishing social and design-focused venue onboard giving Luminara a unique artistic personality.
Enhanced Pool Decks: Expanded outdoor decks tailored for outdoor relaxation, pool time, spa visits, and sunset cocktails.
Luminara Suites: 226 suites with private ocean terraces, luxury finishes, and spacious modern living environments.
competitorStrengths: Who Should Choose Luminara?: Choose Luminara if you want Asia-Pacific itineraries, destination-focused voyages, newer yacht design, maximum space, enhanced pool decks, The Art Bar, and a modern luxury environment.
Luminara Verdict: Best for Itinerary & Space — Best for itinerary-driven travelers and guests who prioritize generous space-per-guest.

finalVerdictSections.heading: Final Verdict: Evrima vs. Ilma vs. Luminara
paragraphs: Choose Evrima if you want intimacy. It is the smallest yacht (298 guests) and provides the strongest private-yacht atmosphere.
Choose Ilma if you want the best all-around balance. It combines luxury, space, modern design and strong independent recognition (Forbes Five-Star).
Choose Luminara if you want space and destination variety. It is especially attractive for Asia-Pacific-focused travelers and guests who value generous space-per-guest.
Our Overall Recommendation: 🥇 Best Overall: Ilma | 🥈 Best for Intimacy: Evrima | 🥉 Best for Space & Asia-Pacific: Luminara

Final Rule: Don't choose the yacht before you choose the itinerary. The perfect Ritz-Carlton yacht is the one that takes you to the destinations you actually want to experience, on dates that work for you, in a suite that fits your travel style.

faqs.question: 1. Is Evrima or Ilma better?
faqs.answer: Neither is universally better. Evrima is smaller and more intimate (298 guests), while Ilma offers more space, larger suite categories, and a newer-generation design (448 guests). Choose Evrima for intimacy and Ilma for a broader range of onboard space and features.

faqs.question: 2. Is Ilma or Luminara better?
faqs.answer: Ilma is particularly attractive for travelers who value its Forbes Five-Star recognition and balanced design, while Luminara is especially compelling for Asia-Pacific itineraries, space-per-guest, and its enhanced pool decks and Art Bar.

faqs.question: 3. Is Evrima or Luminara better?
faqs.answer: Evrima is better for travelers who prioritize intimacy and the original Ritz-Carlton yacht experience. Luminara is better for travelers who prioritize newer design, space, and destination variety.

faqs.question: 4. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is the newest?
faqs.answer: Luminara is currently the newest Ritz-Carlton yacht, having entered service in July 2025.

faqs.question: 5. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is the smallest?
faqs.answer: Evrima is the smallest, with 149 suites and capacity for approximately 298 guests.

faqs.question: 6. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht has the most suites?
faqs.answer: Luminara has 226 suites, slightly more than Ilma's 224 and more than Evrima's 149.

faqs.question: 7. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht has the most guests?
faqs.answer: Luminara accommodates approximately 452 guests, compared with 448 on Ilma and 298 on Evrima.

faqs.question: 8. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht has the best service?
faqs.answer: All three follow the same Ritz-Carlton service philosophy. The individual voyage and crew experience can matter more than the yacht itself.

faqs.question: 9. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is best for couples?
faqs.answer: Evrima has an advantage for couples who prioritize intimacy because it is the smallest yacht. Ilma and Luminara are also excellent choices for couples.

faqs.question: 10. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is best for families?
faqs.answer: Ilma and Luminara can be particularly attractive for families because of their larger public spaces. However, Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is not primarily a children's cruise product.

faqs.question: 11. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is best for Asia?
faqs.answer: Luminara is generally the strongest choice for travelers prioritizing Asia-Pacific itineraries.

faqs.question: 12. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is best for the Caribbean?
faqs.answer: Evrima and Ilma can both be excellent choices for Caribbean voyages depending on the specific itinerary and sailing date.

faqs.question: 13. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is best for the Mediterranean?
faqs.answer: Evrima and Ilma are both strong choices. Compare the specific ports and dates before choosing.

faqs.question: 14. Does every Ritz-Carlton yacht have private terraces?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private terraces are a defining feature of the all-suite yacht concept across all three vessels.

faqs.question: 15. Are the Ritz-Carlton yachts all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: They are designed around an all-inclusive luxury yacht experience, but some expenses remain additional, including certain specialty dining, excursions, spa services, airfare, hotels and personal purchases.

faqs.question: 16. Is Ilma really a Five-Star cruise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Forbes Travel Guide awarded Ilma a Five-Star rating in its 2026 Star Awards and described it as the world's first and only Five-Star cruise at the time of the award.

faqs.question: 17. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht should I book?
faqs.answer: Start with the itinerary. Then consider whether you prioritize intimacy, space, design, destination or specific onboard features. Evrima is strongest for intimacy, Ilma for overall balance and Luminara for space and Asia-Pacific itineraries.
